transit.home_screen_ios: How to add to your Home Screen on iPhone (iOS)
transit.home_screen_ios_body: iPhone (iOS) requires using Safari. Navigate to the website, tap the Share icon (square with an upward arrow) in the toolbar, scroll down, and select Add to Home Screen. You can edit the shortcut name before tapping Add to place the icon on your home screen. This option is not available in third-party browsers like Chrome on iOS.
transit.home_screen_android: How to add to your Home Screen on Android
transit.home_screen_android_body: Android supports adding websites via Google Chrome or other browsers like Samsung Internet and Firefox. In Chrome, open the website, tap the three-dot menu in the top-right corner, and select Add to Home Screen (or Install app if it is a Progressive Web App). Confirm the name and tap Add to place the shortcut on your home screen.
